If a customizing/derivation table search stalls (empty joins, structurally mismatched keys, or the mechanism is simply not configured where standard SAP would put it), pivot to the TRANSACTIONAL documents that the process actually produced. 2. Read a representative sample keyed the same way the decision is made (same company code / same period) and pull BOTH the input key and the resolved output field on the same row. 3. Compute cardinality BOTH ways (key→outputs and output→keys) — the direction that collapses to 1 is where the decision is actually made. 4. This is faster AND more truthful than reconstructing configuration: it does not depend on having found the right customizing table at all.
evidence: brain_v2/methods/algorithm_memory.json subject '_read_the_documents_not_the_configuration'; brain_v2/methods/algorithms.json A16_payroll_end_to_end.seventh_part_added_s098; claims #463/#464

rule: Read the transport TEXT (E07T) before drawing a conclusion from a transport VOLUME trend. A trend measured on object/row counts alone invites a reading the content refutes.
why: s098, A17_change_governance / AN-TRANSPORTED-DATA-LEGITIMACY. Transported table (TABU) content rose roughly tenfold from August to November 2025 on an unchanged transport cadence — read on volume alone, this looks like an intervention in production master data. E07T (the transport texts, previously never extracted — cts_transports was built without as4text) showed the volume was overwhelmingly holiday calendars (137 objects across 12 transports) and HR form scenarios (492 objects): legitimate, routine content, not a data-move incident. The volume-only reading would have escalated a non-issue.
how_to_apply: 1. Before characterizing ANY transport-volume trend (a spike, a rise, an unusual cadence) as suspicious or as evidence of an intervention, pull E07T (or the transport's AS4TEXT) for the objects/transports driving it. 2. Read what the transport SAYS it is for, not just how much it moved. 3. Only escalate a volume trend once the text has been read and does NOT explain it. 4. This generalizes the companion lesson about reading posted documents over configuration: read what was RECORDED about the change (the text), not just what was counted (the volume).
evidence: brain_v2/methods/algorithm_memory.json subject 'transported content' (second entry, 's098', 'the transport TEXT reversed the reading the volume trend suggested'); brain_v2/capability_model/execution_backlog.json AN-TRANSPORTED-DATA-LEGITIMACY (DONE)

rule: A COMPANION NAMES THE OBJECTS. It never reports a count in place of them. If the artefact holds 18 enhancements, the page lists the 18 — each with WHERE it hooks, WHAT FIELD it decides on, WHAT it modifies, and WHETHER THE EFFECT SURVIVES the call. Four structural requirements: (1) every quantity is immediately followed by its enumeration; (2) every object carries its hook, its gate and its effect, not just its name; (3) every figure carries the perimeter it was measured on, in the same cell; (4) the page states which sections are GENERATED from the brain and which are WRITTEN, because only the written ones can go stale.
why: s098, USER on the first budget-rate companion: 'es muy generico, no dice las extensiones que hacen cuales son en que momento, no da ninguna informacion, el nivel de explicacion es pobre'. Correct, and measurable: the page said 'nine enhancements and a control report' while budget_rate_enhancements.json held 18 members each with hook, gate_keyed_on, modifies and persists; 12 moments each with its SAP object, its gate and the DATE it converts on; and 8 named perimeter conditions. Every one of those was summarised away. A COUNT IS WHAT YOU WRITE WHEN YOU HAVE NOT READ THE DATA — and it is indistinguishable, to the reader, from having read it and found nothing. Rebuilt, the same page went from 33 KB of assertions to 45 KB in which a reader can find that ZFIX_EXCHANGERATE_CHECK_CONS hooks CL_FM_EF_POSITION->CHECK_CONSUMPTION, gates on the RESERVATION HEADER currency, and does NOT persist — it restores the value after the standard check.
how_to_apply: Before publishing any companion, take each section and ask: could a reader ACT on this, or does it only tell them a thing exists? 'Nine enhancements' fails; 'ZFIX_EF_FUND_RESERVATION, on KBLP/KBLK during FMX1/FMX2, gating on the reservation header currency, writing hwges — PERSISTS' passes. Render the artefact's own arrays as TABLES rather than prose summaries: the detail is already structured, and summarising structured data into a sentence is a lossy transformation with no benefit. Where an array exists in the source, a table must exist in the page.
cp_derivation_method: CP-002 says lossy compression only at query-time, never at storage-time — and a companion is a QUERY over the brain, not a store. But the compression it applies must be SELECTION (which objects matter here) and never AGGREGATION INTO A COUNT, because a count destroys precisely what a reader came for. CP-003 also binds: 'nine enhancements' is an approximation where an exact enumeration was available at zero cost.
evidence: companions/budget_rate_companion_v1.html §14 (per-extension section, 15 enumerated); brain_v2/budget_rate_enhancements.json (18 members, 12 moments, 8 perimeter conditions)

rule: When a subagent or a background write dies mid-stream, DIFF what it touched before doing anything else. It does not leave a broken file — it leaves a file that is VALID AND DIFFERENT, so parsing it, loading it and running a smoke test all pass.
why: s098. The steward close pass died with 'API Error: Response stalled mid-stream'. It left feedback_rules.json parseable, loadable and wrong: domain_axes — the convention in 144 of 187 rules — replaced by a flat domain field, and the trailing newline dropped. Nothing would have caught it except reading the diff. The same shape of damage is why an interrupted post-INSERT DROP once left FMIOI duplicated and it looked like a clean load.
how_to_apply: On any agent-failure notification: git status, then git diff on every file it named, BEFORE re-running it or committing. Judge each change against the file's OWN convention — count which shape the existing entries use rather than assuming. Keep what the agent got right: here the evidence field it added was useful and only the schema change was wrong. And do NOT re-run a writer that died mid-write until the partial state is resolved. The measured split in s098 was 144 domain_axes / 17 domain / 26 neither, so the majority settled which convention was correct — the file answered the question.
cp_derivation_method: CP-001 is knowledge over velocity: re-running the failed agent is the fast path and it compounds damage over a state nobody inspected. Reading the diff costs one command and is the only thing that sees this class of defect.
evidence: git diff brain_v2/agent_rules/feedback_rules.json after task a3be7b85e103b79e6 failed

rule: Never publish a query, command or reproduction step you have not EXECUTED and seen return the figure you are printing beside it. A recipe you have not run is the same defect as a count you have not read: it looks like knowledge and is a guess — and it is worse, because the reader will trust it enough to act.
why: s098, the 'how to reproduce every figure' section of the budget-rate companion. Nine queries were written, then all nine were run against the golden and each returned its published figure exactly (USD 1,982,154.59 / EUR 796,418.86; net 0.00 per currency; 2,316 runs and 488 posted; 72 configured and 0 posting; 14 fund types). Running them also surfaced what the queries needed to SAY: that ppdit no longer needs a run filter because it is already purged, and that the chain query multiplies because FI summarises several payroll items into one line.
how_to_apply: Write the query, run it, paste the ACTUAL result beside it, and add the caveat that running it taught you. If it cannot be run — because it needs a live system or a table not held — say so in place of the figure rather than printing an expected one.
cp_derivation_method: CP-003 demands verifiable evidence. A published query IS a claim about what the data will say, and an unexecuted one has no evidence behind it at all.
evidence: companions/budget_rate_companion_v1.html §16 (9 recetas); scratchpad repro_test.py

rule: Never judge whether a data field is alive from ONE measurement. Three axes, always together: (1) FILL, tested against the field's own TYPE — a numeric or NUMC column is never blank, it defaults to zero, so use trim(trim(col),'0.') and not a plain not-empty test; (2) TREND, grouped by the ROW's creation date — a flat low rate and a decaying one are opposite findings; (3) CARDINALITY — a field populated on 42% of rows carrying ONE distinct value has a fill rate and no information. A verdict is only trustworthy when all three agree.
why: s098, algorithm A19 over PRPS's 31 custom fields. Each axis alone produced a WRONG answer, measured: a plain not-empty test called ten of the 31 fully populated when YYE_PRCTO is 0.45% real (60,021 of its 60,292 values are '0.00'); YYE_DONOR reads as never-adopted at 18.5% flat and is a twenty-four-year abandonment curve from 82% to 5% once grouped by creation year; and YYE_IMPL_AGENCY is filled on 42% of elements with exactly ONE distinct value, which no fill rate can ever detect. Running all three also found what one axis had hidden — THREE fields abandoning on the same curve, not one, and one field (YYE_APPR_LINE) being ADOPTED that had been read as residual.
how_to_apply: Use A19 (process_mining/wbs_model.py) or replicate its three measurements. If a field has no trend data, report SIN DATOS rather than guessing from the other two. And when reporting, give the reader all three numbers — a verdict without its axes cannot be challenged.
cp_derivation_method: CP-003 requires maximum precision and checkable facts. A single-axis verdict is an approximation presented as a finding, and this rule exists because that approximation was wrong three different ways on the same table.
evidence: brain_v2/project_wbs_model.json (A19); companions/project_wbs_companion_v1.html

rule: A substring match is NOT evidence that a fact is already stored. Before concluding that knowledge is persisted, READ THE RECORD the keyword hit — the same word routinely appears in an unrelated rule. A coverage check that only reports yes/no is a coverage check that will lie to you.
why: s098, twice in one session and in mirror-image forms. First: checking for an existing rule by EXACT ID missed feedback_a_dead_agent_leaves_a_valid_different_file and a duplicate was written. Then, over-correcting, a concept search reported the three-axis method and the authorship lesson as ALREADY PRESENT — 'cardinality' had hit a rule about ROWSKIPS rejection and 'authorship' had hit feedback_only_modify_our_own_code. Both were false positives and both would have left real knowledge in the chat. One failure mode says 'not there' when it is; the other says 'there' when it is not, and the second is worse because it ends the search.
how_to_apply: Print the id and the first line of every record the probe matched, and judge them by eye. Two lines of output turn a boolean into evidence. Do this before writing a new record AND before deciding not to.
cp_derivation_method: CP-001 puts traceability above velocity: a false 'already covered' loses the knowledge silently and nobody ever learns to look for it, which is the irreversible kind of loss.
evidence: scratchpad gap2.py reported SI for both; gap3.py printing the matched records showed neither existed

rule: A rule that can only be obeyed by REMEMBERING it will be broken, including by the agent that wrote it. For any failure that is MECHANICAL — a substitution that must land, an output that must match its generator, a store that must be searched before writing — do not add a rule. Add a CHECK that runs and fails loudly. If the check cannot be written, say so explicitly instead of writing a rule that will read as coverage and provide none.
why: s098, and the evidence is against myself. Rule #180 — 'a silent replace is a silent defect' — ALREADY EXISTED and I broke it FOUR times in this one session: each time a template replace missed its anchor, the script printed OK because the Python still parsed, and the page shipped with a raw token or a stray %s. Every one was caught afterwards, by hand, one at a time. Three companions carried the line 'never edit the HTML, edit the builder' and nothing verified it — when a check was finally written, its FIRST run found budget_rate_graph.json already out of step with its generator, and nobody had known. The dedup discipline failed twice more, in mirror-image forms. Four documented rule-violations by the author of the rules is not a discipline problem; it is proof that rules do not work on mechanical failures.
how_to_apply: When about to write a feedback rule, ask first: could a script detect this violation? If yes, write the script and let the rule point at it. The rules store is for JUDGEMENT — what to measure, what to distrust, when to stop. Mechanical invariants belong in scripts/verify_generated.py, brain_v2/promote.py, brain_v2/verify_claims.py and their siblings, and the close should RUN them rather than recite them.
cp_derivation_method: CP-001 puts traceability above velocity. A rule nobody can execute produces the APPEARANCE of a control while the loss keeps happening silently, which is the irreversible failure it warns against — the loss is invisible precisely because a rule exists.
evidence: scripts/verify_generated.py first run found budget_rate_graph.json drifted; rule #180 existed and was violated 4x in s098; dedup failed 2x

rule: Any automated check that reports CANDIDATES rather than certainties must be able to record 'reviewed and deliberately excluded', with the reason written beside it. Without that, it repeats the same finding every run, the reader learns to skip it, and the control silently becomes decoration — while still appearing to be a control, which is worse than having none. A gate with no memory of its own decisions can only repeat itself.
why: s098, on the first real use of stop_integrity_hook.py. It flagged ten process_mining scripts as absent from the algorithm arsenal. Triaged one by one, EIGHT are helpers or pipeline steps of 54-135 lines, two are analyses, none declares itself an algorithm and none is reusable on another installation — which is the bar. The honest verdict was that NONE should be registered. But that verdict had nowhere to live, so the gate would have reported the same ten every session forever. The degradation the hook was explicitly designed to avoid reappeared through the back door, one commit after the design note warning about it.
how_to_apply: Give the check an explicit exclusion set IN THE CODE, with a comment saying when it was triaged and on what basis — never a silent filter. Then verify BOTH directions: that it goes quiet on the reviewed set, and that it still fires on a newly introduced case. The second test is the one that proves the exclusion did not just switch the check off.
cp_derivation_method: CP-001 values traceability: an exclusion with its reason recorded is traceable, while a check quietly ignored by its reader loses the signal AND the record that a decision was ever made.
evidence: brain_v2/stop_integrity_hook.py NOT_ALGORITHMS; verified quiet on the ten and firing on a new file

rule: A backup that has never been RESTORED is a hypothesis. Every backup this project writes must ship with a rehearsed restore, and the recovery runbook must live in the REPO so it can be read from origin when the machine it describes is gone. Six rules: MEASURE before designing (the irreplaceable asset is rarely the big one); EXCLUDE with the reason written down; VERIFY the exclusion by reading the written package, not by trusting the filter; REFUSE to write an empty backup; RESTORE to a staging directory, never over the live target; and state explicitly what is NOT recoverable.
why: s098. Every session close for months had RESTATED that the Golden DB and ~/.claude are local-only and git does not protect them. When it was finally checked there were ZERO copies of either and no script to make one — stating a risk is not managing it, and a reminder that repeats and is never executed is the APPEARANCE of a control, which is worse than none because nobody looks again. The same session also had 73 unpushed commits: git protects nothing you have not pushed. And measuring inverted the intuition — 1,836 MB of transcripts and 16.33 GB of database are both reconstructible, while the 1.5 MB of memory is the only thing nothing can rebuild. Then TESTING the backup found it captured 4 files and zero memory (pathlib resolves `dir/**` as directories, not recursive files) AND wrote the package anyway.
how_to_apply: Follow the universal standard at ecosystem-coordinator/.knowledge/way-of-working/project-durability-and-recovery.md. Reference implementation: scripts/backup_golden.py (both assets, one --dest) and knowledge/recovery_runbook.md. Rehearse with `--restore <pkg> --to <tmp>` and paste the ACTUAL output into the runbook — the last real drill, not the expected one. And bound the worst case for reconstructible assets with a manifest of what was loaded and under which rules; without it recovery is archaeology, with it it is a script.
cp_derivation_method: CP-001 puts traceability above velocity and calls losing it irreversible. Losing the memory of WHY a decision was made is the purest form of that loss, and it is the asset with the least protection precisely because it is the smallest.
evidence: knowledge/recovery_runbook.md; drill 595 files in / 595 out / 474 memory, OK; scripts/backup_golden.py aborts below 50 memory files

rule: Triage every support item into one of TWO tracks BEFORE any lookup or analysis. TRACK A = DIAGNOSIS: the unknown is why the system behaved this way; the output is a root cause. TRACK B = OPERATIONAL ACTION: what to do is already known and executing it correctly is the work; the output is an executed, verified change plus the reusable procedure. Tell them apart in one read: an action verb aimed at a named person/entity from someone with the authority to ask for it is B; a symptom, an error number, a 'this fails' is A. Ambiguous items default to A unless there is an authorizing document, in which case they are B.
why: s099. The skill had one protocol shaped entirely around diagnosis, so the operational changes (INC-000006313, INC-000011781) were pushed through a root-cause workflow that asks the wrong questions. Track B's risks are not Track A's: A fails by chasing the wrong mechanism (INC-000005240 burned 154K tokens on FMDERIVE), B fails by executing the requester's summary instead of the authority and by never looking at the population around the change. One protocol for both means one set of blind spots applied to work that does not share them.
how_to_apply: Step 0 of .agents/skills/sap_incident_analyst/SKILL.md. State the track explicitly in your first response on the ticket, and say why. If you find yourself writing 'how it should work' for a request that is just 'add this person', you triaged wrong. Both tracks still share: BRAIN LOOKUP, provisional-until-confirmed, the user gate, and rebuild-only-at-the-end.
cp_derivation_method: CP-003 demands precision anchored in evidence. Naming the kind of work before doing it is the first precision available; skipping it makes every later step approximate.
evidence: .agents/skills/sap_incident_analyst/SKILL.md Step 0; INC-000006313 + INC-000011781 vs INC-000005240

rule: On any operational change, the authorizing DOCUMENT is the specification — never the requester's summary. Read the TRS letter, the bank carton, the signed approval, and execute the full set of operations it mandates, including the ones nobody mentioned. No authority document = no change spec; stop and ask.
why: INC-000011781. The request said 'can you please add Renata RITTER for UBO in BCM'. The two authoritative TRS letters (FIN.8/MOD/10.0000003618 and ...3617, both 24/03/2026) said ADD Ritter AND DELETE Von Michael MARTIN. Executing the note would have added the new signatory and left an unauthorized one active on two bank accounts. A requester's note is a pointer to the change, not the change.
how_to_apply: Track B step B1. Record the authority reference, its date, its effective date, and the complete operation list. Use the authority's effective date as BEGDA, not the execution date — INC-000006313 used the execution date and opened a 7-day audit gap for nothing.
cp_derivation_method: CP-003 requires verifiable evidence behind every action. A forwarded sentence is not evidence of what was authorized; the signed letter is.
evidence: knowledge/incidents/INC-000011781_ubo_bcm_add_ritter.md §1-§4; INC-000006313 BEGDA gap

rule: After executing an operational change, reconcile the ENTIRE population against the authority — not just the row you touched. Whatever the sweep finds becomes a recurring check under Zagentexecution/quality_checks/. This is Track B's equivalent of Track A's class generalization: one ticket, one standing control.
why: INC-000011781. Nobody asked us to audit the UBO panel; the ask was to add one person. The sweep against the carton found De Sousa Carvalho 10016038 active on all 4 nodes with full signing rights and BCM_REV_REJ_PAY since Jan-2024 while absent from the carton — roughly 18 months of over-authorization that no standing control was looking for. The ticket was not the finding; the ticket was the occasion to look.
how_to_apply: Track B step B8. Diff the system population against the authority document, both directions (present-but-unauthorized AND authorized-but-missing). Promote the diff to a script. The BCM family is the worked pattern: bcm_signatory_reconciliation_check.py, bcm_role_gap_check.py, bcm_release_vs_approve.py.
cp_derivation_method: CP-001 puts knowledge above velocity. Closing the ticket at the row you changed is the fast path; sweeping the population is where the ticket turns into knowledge that outlives it.
evidence: knowledge/incidents/INC-000011781_ubo_bcm_add_ritter.md §0; Zagentexecution/quality_checks/bcm_*.py

rule: Track the occurrence count of every operational scenario. 1st occurrence leaves an incident doc + a first-class record + the rules doc that explains target selection. 2nd occurrence MUST leave a procedure doc + a recurring check + a companion, so the 3rd is mechanical. From the 3rd on, execute from the procedure; if you had to re-derive anything, the procedure was incomplete and fixing it is part of that ticket.
why: s099. This is how the ecosystem gets cheaper instead of merely busier. The BCM signatory pattern proves it: the 2nd execution (INC-000011781) was faster than the 1st (INC-000006313) AND caught drift the 1st never looked for, because the 1st had left behind bcm_signatory_rules.md and a reconciliation check. Without that promotion step, each ticket re-derives the same mechanism and the cost per ticket stays flat forever.
how_to_apply: Track B step B9. Before closing, ask: how many times have we done this scenario? Look it up via the incident records' `scenario` field. If the answer is >=2 and there is no procedure doc, writing it is part of the ticket, not a nice-to-have.
cp_derivation_method: CP-001: velocity that leaves no trace is the expensive kind. A procedure written on the 2nd occurrence is traceability that pays compound interest.
evidence: INC-000006313 -> INC-000011781; knowledge/domains/Treasury/bcm_signatory_change_solution_design.md

rule: An incident is not captured until it has a first-class record in brain_v2/incidents/incidents.json. A markdown file under knowledge/incidents/ is prose on disk: BRAIN LOOKUP traverses brain_state.incidents -> indexes.by_incident -> objects[X], and a doc with no record is in none of those. Gate it with Zagentexecution/quality_checks/incident_record_coverage_check.py.
why: s099 opened and found 11 docs on disk against 7 records. Three incidents were invisible: INC-000011781 (the richest BCM signatory precedent we have — IT1218 node selection, the drift sweep, the role gap), INC-180995 and INC-CLASS-LOSS-2026-06. The PMO had recorded 'TODO: run rebuild_all.py to fold INC-000011781 in' on 2026-06-18 and it never ran. A TODO is not a control; the next agent on a sibling BCM ticket would have started from zero.
how_to_apply: Write the record in the SAME action as the doc, never 'later'. Before closing any support work run the check (exit 0 = clean) and then rebuild. If you only have time for one of the two artifacts, write the record — a record without prose is still findable; prose without a record is not.
cp_derivation_method: CP-001 calls lost traceability irreversible. Knowledge that exists but cannot be reached by the traversal the protocol mandates is, operationally, lost.
evidence: Zagentexecution/quality_checks/incident_record_coverage_check.py; incidents.json 7 -> 10 records s099

rule: A search that returns nothing is evidence about the SEARCH, not about the system. Before concluding 'X does not exist', prove the search could have found X: check the file ENCODING (UTF-16 returns 0 for every ASCII pattern), the CASE (ABAP source is conventionally lowercase; SAP field names are quoted uppercase in docs), and whether you searched the FULL body or a stub. Then check the ABSTRACTION: a table-level search cannot see logic that lives behind an exit call — GB931 holds CHECKID '=U917', never the field the FORM reads.
why: s099. Claim 116 was published TIER_1 saying the PPC capture control did not exist, on the strength of 'zero matches for LZBKZ in YRGGBS00's 1,592-line source'. The file is UTF-16 and the ABAP is lowercase; FORM u917 sits at line 1547 and blocks the posting. Three silent failures stacked — wrong encoding, wrong case, and a corpus copy that was a 29-line stub. On that claim a KU was opened proposing four ways to BUILD a control that already existed, waiting on a decision from two named people. A zero-result search feels like evidence of absence and is the cheapest way to publish a confident lie.
how_to_apply: Positive control first: grep for something you KNOW is in the file (its own FORM names, 'ENDFORM') and confirm you get hits. If that returns 0, your pipeline is broken, not the system. Use `python brain_v2/graph_queries.py code <obj>` to get the encoding-normalised primary source and the STUB_AT_CANONICAL flag before grepping, and `graph_queries.py section <routine>` / `blocking_code` instead of raw text search for behaviour. State the negative as 'not found by <method>', never as 'does not exist'.
cp_derivation_method: CP-003 demands verifiable evidence. An empty result set is only evidence once the method is shown capable of producing a non-empty one.
evidence: Zagentexecution/mcp-backend-server-python/YRGGBS00_SOURCE.txt:1547 FORM u917 vs claim 116 layer (4); claim 484 supersedes 116

rule: Never SUM a document amount without grouping by its currency, and never label the result with a currency you did not convert into. REGUH-RWBTR, BSEG-DMBTR/WRBTR, FPAYP-* are all in the document or payment currency. If a total must span currencies, either group by WAERS and report the vector, or convert explicitly and say so.
why: s099. I reported Egypt's Citi exposure as 'USD 3,285,100' from SUM(RWBTR) over rows that were mostly EGP. The largest entries were 360,600 and 200,000 EGP — about USD 7,200 and USD 4,000. That single number turned a routine country configuration into what I presented as an order-of-magnitude outlier, and it drove a wrong recommendation until JP challenged it. A cross-currency sum is not merely imprecise; it manufactures a finding that does not exist.
how_to_apply: Any SELECT that sums an amount must carry its currency field in the GROUP BY, or the query is wrong. When comparing entities, prefer COUNTS or shares — they are currency-free. State the currency of every figure you report, and if it is a mix, say 'mixed currencies, not summable'.
cp_derivation_method: CP-003 demands exact numbers with checkable provenance. An amount without its unit is not a number, and a sum across units is not a measurement.
evidence: claims 492 -> 493; REGUH RWBTR/WAERS for the 58 EG Citi-routed lines

rule: When one sub-check inside a multi-check script cannot run (a precondition is missing — a table absent from the Gold DB, a source unreachable, an input undefined), the script must report that sub-check as SKIPPED, with a distinct signal (message + a different exit code from clean-pass), and must NEVER fold its absence into an overall PASS message that names the untested condition as satisfied.
why: s099. Zagentexecution/quality_checks/ppc_country_consistency_check.py's check D (degenerate usage) needs REGUP, which is not in the Gold DB. The first version printed a NOTE that check D was skipped, then — because no other check produced a finding — printed 'PASS ... and no degenerate usage' and exited 0. That sentence asserts the one thing that was never measured. This is adjacent to rule #180 (a silent replace is a silent defect) but the mechanism is different: #180 is a WRITE that silently no-ops while the script still reports success; this is a READ that silently cannot execute while the script's SUMMARY still claims full coverage. Both are 'green paint over an unknown', but the fix lives in different code (a text-replace guard vs a coverage-aware exit path), so this is its own rule, not a duplicate.
how_to_apply: Any script with more than one independent sub-check must track which sub-checks actually executed. If any did not, the closing message must name it explicitly as SKIPPED (never silently merged into the aggregate verdict) and the script should return a THIRD exit code (not 0=clean, not 1=finding) so a caller cannot mistake 'ran clean' for 'ran completely'. See the fix applied the same session: Zagentexecution/quality_checks/ppc_country_consistency_check.py now returns 3 when any check is skipped, with the skipped list printed even inside an otherwise-PASS run.
cp_derivation_method: CP-003 demands that a claim (here, a script's PASS verdict) be anchored in checkable evidence. A PASS that includes an untested dimension is precision theater: it reads as measured and is actually approximated by omission.
evidence: Zagentexecution/quality_checks/ppc_country_consistency_check.py (fixed s099, exit 3 path added); prior text: 'PASS - every configured country has ... and no degenerate usage' printed while check D was skipped for lack of REGUP in the Gold DB

rule: Storing knowledge is not the same as making it recoverable. Knowledge is LANDED only when it is reachable from the files a fresh session actually reads first - brain_v2/BRAIN_INDEX.md and MEMORY.md - not merely when a store was written.
why: Session #099 landed a complete Purpose of Payment analysis (claims 484-496, two companions, source doc, closed research, first-class incident record) and then measured the entry points: BRAIN_INDEX.md had ZERO mentions of PPC, Egypt or T015L, and so did MEMORY.md, while graph_queries.py incident INC-EGYPT-PPC returned the complete ten-code fix and transport order. The knowledge was durable, queryable and UNREACHABLE: the only way to find it was to already know the incident id, which is exactly what a new session does not know. The index printed '14 incidents' as a COUNT. A count is not a pointer. CP-001: losing traceability is irreversible.
how_to_apply:
1. Before closing, run the fresh-session probe instead of asserting coverage: grep BRAIN_INDEX.md and MEMORY.md for the session's key terms. Zero hits means the work is invisible however well stored.
2. Fix at the GENERATOR (brain_v2/build_brain_index.py), never by hand-editing the generated index - it is rewritten on every rebuild and a hand edit is lost.
3. Prefer a fix that covers the NEXT case, not this one: the s099 fix was an OPEN WORK block listing every incident awaiting action, deadline first, with its next_action and drill command - not a hardcoded line about Egypt.
4. No silent caps. The first version capped the list at 8 of 9 live incidents and left INC-FXREVAL-OB09 unreachable; the check caught it on its first run.
5. It is MECHANIZED, not a habit: Zagentexecution/quality_checks/knowledge_reachability_check.py runs in the gate tier of every rebuild and fails when an open incident is not reachable, or when one with a deadline has no next_action.

rule: NEVER invoke a SAP write script from this project. Deploying ABAP is OUT OF SCOPE here. Before running ANY script whose name contains deploy/write/reconstruct/insert/install, check brain_v2/capability_ownership.json - if the capability has no owner, the answer is not 'pick the least bad script', it is 'this does not happen here'.
why: MEASURED s099: 91 scripts in this repo can write to SAP and only 3 have the ALLOW_D01_WRITES kill-switch. The other 88 carry 148 write calls behind no gate, and 68 of them sit in Zagentexecution/mcp-backend-server-python/. They are unused and unreferenced, which IS the danger: a future session finds one and runs it believing it is how we deploy. This is exactly the class of tool that caused INC-CLASS-LOSS (2026-06-12) - writing in place, no transport, no review, on N_MENARD objects we do not own.
how_to_apply:
1. The scope answer comes first: this project READS SAP, extracts to the golden, analyses the extracted corpus, and builds the brain. It does not write.
2. A kill-switch is not an architecture. ALLOW_D01_WRITES blocks 3 scripts; 88 were never behind it. Do not treat 'the switch is off' as safety.
3. Do NOT connect the MCP server to get a nicer surface - it never ran, and it would bring adt_deploy (no gates) and brain_search (a different brain source).
4. Do not delete them either. Deleting code is not governing it, and two of those scripts are the record of how INC-CLASS-LOSS was recovered. They are inventoried in brain_v2/sap_write_tool_inventory.json and reported every run by capability_ownership_check.py.
5. If a write genuinely has to happen, it happens in the project that owns that capability, through a RELEASED transport, with 4-eyes - never from here.

rule: Do not reach for multi-agent orchestration to answer a question a single read can answer. Before launching a workflow, ask: what is the cheapest thing that would settle this? If the answer is 'a grep', run the grep.
why: s099: I launched a 5-lens workflow with per-finding refuters to decide whether a 200-line module should exist. It consumed the user's machine to 100%, returned NOTHING (it died with no completion record and no partial results), and cost about two hours. The question it was meant to settle — does a golden-DB helper already exist? — was answered afterwards in three seconds by one grep that found `import golden_hub as _gh` on line 548. Heavy machinery is not thoroughness; it is a bet, and a bet that returns nothing is worse than a cheap answer that returns something.
how_to_apply:
1. Name the single fact that would decide the question. If one file read or one grep produces it, do that first.
2. Reserve fan-out for work that is genuinely wide: many files, many independent angles, no single decisive fact.
3. Consider the machine. A rebuild had just finished; the box was already loaded. Cost is not only tokens.
4. A background job that dies leaves NOTHING. Prefer a sequence of cheap steps whose partial results survive.

rule: Deprecate a COMPONENT, never a directory. Before declaring anything dead, read what it imports and what imports it.
why: s099: I declared Zagentexecution/mcp-backend-server-python/ deprecated as a whole because sap_mcp_server.py had never run. That directory also holds golden_hub.py and rfc_helpers.py — plain Python modules with no `mcp` dependency that work today and are the authoritative implementations of their capabilities. The server imports golden_hub, not the other way round (line 548). I then spent an hour rebuilding golden_hub from scratch because I had declared it dead without reading it.
how_to_apply:
1. `grep -n '^import\|^from' <file>` before deprecating anything — what a module depends on tells you whether it is bound to the dead layer.
2. A shared directory is a filing decision, not an architectural boundary.
3. Record the correction where the wrong claim lives, so the next session does not inherit it.

rule: A guarded path must cover the whole surface it guards. If it refuses part of the data, people route around it — and routing around loses the guarantee for EVERYTHING, not just for the refused part. Degrade with a warning instead of refusing.
why: s099, measured: golden_hub's manifest described 308 tables while the golden holds 369 tables and 5 views, so it refused 66 objects — including E070/E07T (transports), T512W (payroll) and bseg_union, which IS this project's documented Golden Query. That is why the session wrote ~15 ad-hoc sqlite3 snippets instead of calling it, and every one of those lost the provenance the guard exists to supply.
how_to_apply: Read what exists; attach `provenance_verified=false` with the reason when the metadata cannot vouch for it. The caller gets the data AND is told how far to trust it. Reserve hard refusal for what genuinely does not exist.

rule: The moment a topic or domain is named, run `python brain_v2/load_domain.py <topic>` and READ EVERY PART IT EMITS, before proposing, diagnosing or answering. The BRAIN_INDEX orients; it does not make you competent. graph_queries drills return fragments, not the domain's body of knowledge.
why: Session #100: asked to work a DMEE bank-file error, the agent read BRAIN_INDEX + a graph_queries search + 230 lines of one doc and declared itself ready. On disk, unread, sat 40 domain docs, 20 companions, 165 claims and 11 incidents -- ~667K tokens of existing, verified knowledge. Tiered bootstrap (s079) solved context rot at BOOTSTRAP and created a hole at WORK: nothing existed between the 4KB index and the 400K brain, so every session re-discovered its own corpus by grepping and the user had to demand the load, every time. Re-discovery is not free: it burns the session, it is incomplete, and it silently re-derives what is already verified (violates CP-001 traceability and CP-003 evidence).
how_to_apply: 1) User names a subject -> `python brain_v2/load_domain.py <topic>` (aliases: dmee, ppc, sepa, citi, cgi, f110, bcm, ebs, avc, budget, travel, payroll, transport; or any domain name; `--list` to see them). 2) Read part_01..part_NN IN ORDER -- all of them. 3) Read the PERIPHERAL list; pull by path anything the question actually needs. 4) ONLY THEN reason. If the load is too large for the remaining budget, say so with the measured number and read the CORE docs + companions first -- never silently skip and never claim readiness you do not have. 5) If the topic resolves to no domain, add the alias to ALIASES in load_domain.py rather than grepping ad hoc. MECANIZADA: brain_v2/session_start_hook.py exige el load_domain en cuanto se nombra un tema.

rule: Que hoy lo acepten NO es evidencia de que cumplira cuando la regla entre en vigor. Ante un cambio normativo con fecha, medir SIEMPRE contra la regla publicada, nunca contra el comportamiento observado durante el periodo de gracia.
why: 2026-08-19: reporte 'CITI no lo rechazara' apoyandome en que 11.185 pagos pasaron en 2026. JP lo corto: 'hoy no los rechaza porque no esta en vigencia la direccion estructurada'. Tenia razon: la aceptacion actual era ausencia de control, no conformidad. Con la base correcta, la exposicion del rail CITI son 5.239 pagos (46%) sin CtrySubDvsn contra una regla escrita — pasa de 'apuesta si endurecen' a trabajo con fecha.
how_to_apply: Cuando exista deadline regulatorio: (1) evaluar contra el texto de la norma, no contra el historico de aceptacion; (2) si la herramienta tiene modo futuro — como pain001_address_validator.py --after-nov2026 — usarlo SIEMPRE, no solo cuando lo pidan; (3) no presentar 'pasa hoy' como tranquilizador sin decir que la regla aun no aplica.

rule: Ante una pregunta sobre un sistema CONFIGURADO (arboles DMEE, customizing, jerarquias), construir o refrescar su MAPA COMPLETO antes de responder — no solo la parte que la pregunta toca. Una sonda por pregunta re-deriva una foto parcial cada vez y omite EN SILENCIO lo que la pregunta no nombro.
why: 2026-08-19: se entrego una especificacion de cambio del CdtrAgt de CGI leyendo solo el mapping. En ese arbol 392 de 628 nodos (62%) cuelgan de un exit que no se estaba mirando. Se analizaron 3 arboles habiendo 6 formatos vivos. JP tuvo que decirlo dos veces: 'estan los codigos de las extensiones para cada elemento' y 'eso aplica a todos los arboles y eso es lo que mas me preocupa que desconoces'. Cuando por fin se construyo el mapa entero tardo 90 segundos y encontro tres defectos que ninguna sonda habia visto, incluido un orden ISO roto en /SEPA_CT_UNES que llevaba meses latente.
how_to_apply: Existe la herramienta: dmee_tree_map.py para formatos de pago. Para otros sistemas, construirla antes de responder la primera pregunta. El mapa se GENERA y lleva fecha de medida; no se escribe a mano, porque un doc de configuracion escrito a mano se desincroniza en la primera edicion y se lee como si fuera cierto. MECANIZADA: brain_v2/session_start_hook.py lo inyecta en cada arranque; Zagentexecution/quality_checks/dmee_tree_map.py es el mapa para formatos de pago.

rule: Toda medida sobre una tabla transaccional declara PRIMERO sus dimensiones discriminantes. Omitir una inventa un problema o esconde otro. En pagos (REGUH) son tres: DORIGIN (quien cobra -- cada origen tiene su fuente de verdad), T042Z (por donde sale -- FORMI=fichero, XSCHK=cheque), y el rail (contra que regla se mide -- los bancos no piden lo mismo).
why: 2026-08-19, el mismo error tres veces en un dia. Sin DORIGIN: veredicto '99% sano' con el 35% de las lineas fuera de la foto, porque los receptores de nomina son PERNR y no existen en LFA1. Sin T042Z: se abrio un incidente GRAVE diciendo que 943 empleados no podrian cobrar; cobran por CHEQUE y un cheque no lleva PstlAdr — el incidente era inexistente. Filtrando de mas por rail: 941 proveedores reportados cuando eran 8.149.
how_to_apply: Antes de lanzar la consulta, escribir los cortes y por que cada uno discrimina. Si no se sabe nombrar el corte, no se entiende la tabla todavia. Ver la cabecera de structured_address_readiness.py, que los lleva escritos con el error que costo cada uno. MECANIZADA: los tres cortes (DORIGIN, T042Z, rail) estan DENTRO de Zagentexecution/quality_checks/structured_address_readiness.py, no en un comentario; y session_start_hook.py los nombra al arrancar.

rule: Toda herramienta reutilizable lleva un test que corre SIN conexion, y sus casos son errores REALES ya cometidos, no ejemplos inventados: asi el test documenta la trampa ademas de vigilarla.
why: 2026-08-19: el test de structured_address_readiness.py tardo cinco minutos en escribirse y caza en el acto que el detector de codigos postales comodin anclaba al final y NO reconocia '99999-9999' ni 'Z9Z 9Z9' — 64 de los 68 casos reales. Sin el, habria vuelto a derivar Alaska para una direccion de New York y cargado el dato falso en el maestro. No se vio leyendo el codigo: se vio ejecutandolo.
how_to_apply: test_<herramienta>.py junto a la herramienta, ejecutable sin SAP, cubriendo las funciones puras: claves, clasificaciones, detecciones. Cada caso con un comentario de que error real representa. MECANIZADA: Zagentexecution/quality_checks/run_all_tests.py corre todos los test_*.py y esta enganchado al hook Stop, asi que se ejecuta al cerrar.

rule: Por cada regla nueva que se anada al brain, convertir una vieja en comprobacion EJECUTABLE o retirarla. Una regla que exige recordarla no es un mecanismo: es una nota.
why: 2026-08-19: hay 209 feedback rules. En esta sesion se fallo contra al menos cinco, incluida feedback_load_the_domain_before_you_reason (CRITICAL) escrita por el propio agente TRES HORAS ANTES de volver a violarla. Lo que si funciono fue lo que estaba dentro de una herramienta: el validador cazo el error de orden, el mapa cazo el nodo que no emitia, el test cazo el detector roto. Anadir la regla 210 no mejora nada.
how_to_apply: Al cerrar sesion, por cada regla nueva elegir una existente y (a) mecanizarla en un check ejecutable, o (b) retirarla si ya no aplica. Preferir siempre mecanizar sobre escribir. MECANIZADA: Zagentexecution/quality_checks/rules_mechanization_check.py mide el % del corpus con algo ejecutable detras y nombra las CRITICAL huerfanas. Enganchado al hook Stop. Linea base 2026-08-19: 14 de 213 (6%).

rule: Antes de escribir un registro en un store del brain (claims, incidents, rules), LEER como estan escritos los que ya existen y usar SUS claves. No inventar el esquema.
why: 2026-08-19: se anadieron 15 claims con claves inventadas — 'statement' en vez de 'claim', 'evidence' en vez de 'evidence_for', 'created' en vez de 'created_session', y confidence='high' donde el store usa TIER_1/2/3. El rebuild se cayo en el paso 2 con KeyError: 'claim', y los 15 claims —incluido el que cierra el rechazo bancario del 21-07— estaban en el fichero pero NO en el estado agregado. Nadie se habria enterado hasta el siguiente rebuild. El error de fondo no es tipografico: es escribir sin leer. Y NO SOLO LAS CLAVES: tambien el FORMATO. Se edito claims.json con indent=1 y verify_claims.py lo devolvio a indent=2 en el siguiente rebuild -> 48.168 lineas de diff con CERO claims cambiados. store_schema_check.py comprueba ahora el indent canonico de cada store ademas del esquema.
how_to_apply: MECANIZADA: Zagentexecution/quality_checks/store_schema_check.py deduce el esquema por mayoria y avisa de las desviaciones; enganchado al hook Stop. Al escribir a mano: leer un registro existente del mismo store y copiar sus claves.

rule: Un espacio AL FINAL de un campo CHAR no existe: es indistinguible del relleno y no hay forma de almacenarlo. Un espacio AL PRINCIPIO si sobrevive. Y ninguna configuracion basada en texto se da por buena mirando la pantalla: se lee el campo EN CRUDO, sin strip, y se compara con una fila que ya funcione.
why: 2026-08-19, configurando Purpose of Payment para Egipto, TRES defectos seguidos vivieron en el mismo sitio: (1) los seis SEPARATOR de YTFI_PPC_STRUC se dejaron VACIOS con el razonamiento 'la estructura es texto simple, no necesita separaciones' -- pero YCL_IDFI_CGI_DMEE_UTIL->BUILD_VALUE es literalmente ev_value_c = |{ iv_value_c }{ iv_value_to_add }|, concatenacion directa SIN separador implicito, asi que el fichero habria salido 'Payment for goods or services receivedINV5105551234', todo pegado; (2) se intento poner el separador como un espacio, y PPC_VALUE es CHAR(60) -- el blanco final se pierde porque ES el relleno; (3) T015L EG4 se grabo como 'OTHR  Others' con DOS espacios, y como el SPLIT AT SPACE parte en el PRIMERO y mete el resto -separadores incluidos- en el ultimo destino, la descripcion salia como ' Others' y el fichero habria llevado '/ Others/INV/...'. LOS TRES ERAN INVISIBLES EN SM30: un separador vacio parece vacio a proposito, y dos espacios seguidos no se distinguen de uno. Los tres los cazo la MISMA herramienta: RFC_READ_TABLE sin .strip(), contando los blancos delante y detras. Yo mismo di primero una explicacion equivocada del blanco final (culpe a la plantilla de string ABAP) antes de mirar el DDIC y ver que el motivo real es el relleno del CHAR: misma accion, explicacion un nivel por debajo de la verdad.
how_to_apply: MECANIZADA en Zagentexecution/quality_checks/ppc_country_consistency_check.py, checks E y F: E marca todo SEPARATOR con PPC_VALUE en blanco (no separa: pega), y F marca todo ZWCK1 cuyo hueco entre codigo y narrativa no sea exactamente un espacio. En su primera ejecucion, el 2026-08-19, el check F encontro un defecto VIVO en P01 que nadie buscaba: T015L INA con dos espacios (claim 529). Al configurar o revisar cualquier tabla que componga texto: (1) leer el campo con RFC_READ_TABLE SIN strip y mostrar los blancos, p.ej. valor.replace(' ','.') mas el conteo de blancos iniciales; (2) comparar contra una fila de un pais/entidad que YA funcione en produccion -- la diferencia salta sola; (3) si hace falta separacion visible, ponerla DELANTE de un literal, nunca detras, y nunca justo antes de un campo dinamico tipo PAY_FIELD, que no admite prefijo: ahi el separador tiene que ser el ultimo caracter no blanco del bloque anterior; (4) antes de dar por buena la config, SIMULAR la cadena montada y compararla con la salida real. Claim 524.

rule: Antes de liberar un transporte de customizing, diferenciar la TABLA ENTERA entre origen y destino -- no solo las claves que querias tocar -- y listar las claves que el transporte lleva de verdad. Mantener una entidad en SM30 puede capturar la clave de una entidad VECINA.
why: 2026-08-19: configurando Egipto en YTFI_PPC_STRUC se borro sin querer el separador '/' de la fila ID/USTRD/O/01 -- INDONESIA -- y esa clave, 350ID USTRD O01, quedo DENTRO del transporte de Egipto (D01K9B0FXF, 17 claves: 10 de EG + 1 de ID + 5 T015L + 1 TAG). Liberado en ese estado habria cambiado Indonesia de '/PURP/<cod>/<XBLNR>' a 'PURP/<cod>/<XBLNR>' contra Bank Indonesia, sobre 921 lineas con codigo de proposito. NINGUNA revision centrada en 'esta Egipto bien configurado?' lo habria visto: la config de Egipto era correcta. Lo vio el diff de TODA la tabla D01 vs P01, que devolvio exactamente una deriva no-Egipto. Y hay un segundo motivo para hacer el diff completo: revela tambien la deriva que NO viaja (en el mismo diff aparecio T015L DK1, presente en D01, ausente de P01 y fuera del transporte). MATIZ QUE HAY QUE SABER: un transporte de tabla guarda la CLAVE y exporta el VALOR al LIBERAR, no al capturarlo -- por eso restaurar el valor neutraliza el dano aunque la clave siga dentro, pero deja la entidad vecina ACOPLADA al transporte hasta la liberacion.
how_to_apply: ⛔ LA MECANIZACION NO ESTA DISPONIBLE (2026-08-26). EL DIFF MANUAL SIGUE SIENDO EL METODO: leer las tablas del transporte ENTERAS en origen y destino y comparar fila a fila. `Zagentexecution/quality_checks/config_transport_prerelease_check.py` esta en DEFECTO_VIVO y NO puede usarse como puerta de liberacion, por DOS motivos medidos: (a) SOBRE LA ORDEN -- que es lo que se libera -- devuelve exit 0 sin analizar nada, porque las claves de customizing viven en E071K de la TAREA. Medido: la orden de Egipto D01K9B0FXE imprime 'E071K vacio' y sale 0, mientras su hija D01K9B0FXF sale 1 con la clave INTRUSA de Indonesia '350/ID/USTRD/O/01'. Mismo dia, misma herramienta, veredictos opuestos, y el objeto que se libera es el que dice OK. (b) EL VEREDICTO 'INTRUSA' PUEDE SER FALSO POR VACUIDAD: la condicion (l.210) exige que el eje de entidad tenga mas de un valor, y ese eje se deriva como el primer campo clave tras MANDT. En T030H eso es KTOPL, y en D01 solo existe UNES -- asi que la condicion no puede cumplirse NUNCA y el discriminador real (HKONT) no se mira. Un '0 INTRUSA' de esa tabla no significa 'limpio': significa 'no comprobado'. MIENTRAS NO SE ARREGLE: (1) diff manual de la tabla entera; (2) si usas el check, correlo sobre las TAREAS HIJAS (E070.STRKORR), nunca sobre la orden sola; (3) no leas su exit 0 como aprobacion. ARREGLO PENDIENTE: si E071K esta vacio, resolver las hijas y analizar la UNION; si no hay hijas, salir 2 (no analizable), nunca 0. Claims 526, 598.
_how_to_apply_retirado: MECANIZADA: python Zagentexecution/quality_checks/config_transport_prerelease_check.py <TRKORR> [--src D01 --dst P01]. Lee E071K para saber que tablas y claves lleva el transporte, diferencia CADA tabla entera entre los dos sistemas y clasifica: (a) dentro del transporte y distinto -> viaja, verificar que es intencionado; (b) FUERA del transporte y distinto -> deriva que no viaja; (c) dentro del transporte e igual -> no-op, candidata a quitar de la lista de objetos. Exit code != 0 si hay claves dentro del transporte que no pertenecen a la entidad que se estaba manteniendo. Correr SIEMPRE antes de liberar. Claim 526.
_retirado_por_que: prometia 'Exit code != 0 si hay claves ajenas' y 'Correr SIEMPRE antes de liberar': sobre la ORDEN no hay exit != 0 posible. Una regla CRITICAL que promete una puerta que no puede disparar es peor que no tener regla -- certifica

rule: Cuando exista el codigo que construye una salida, SIMULARLO sobre la configuracion real y PUBLICAR la prediccion ANTES de generarla. Comparar despues caracter por caracter. Mirar la salida y decir 'parece correcta' no es verificar.
why: 2026-08-19: antes de lanzar el F110 se simulo CM003/CM004 sobre las filas leidas en vivo y se predijo '/Payment for goods or services received/INV/224938'. El fichero pain.001 generado trajo exactamente esa cadena. Eso valida DOS cosas de un golpe y las separa: que la configuracion es correcta, Y que nuestro modelo del codigo es correcto. Si hubieran diferido, la diferencia habria dicho cual de las dos estaba mal -- que es informacion que 'leer el fichero y ver si tiene buena pinta' no da nunca. La misma simulacion, corrida antes, es la que hizo visibles los separadores vacios y el doble espacio: la prediccion es tambien el detector.
how_to_apply: Antes de ejecutar el proceso real: (1) leer la configuracion en vivo, sin strip; (2) escribir una funcion corta que replique el algoritmo del codigo extraido -- no el de la especificacion, el del fuente; (3) imprimir la cadena/valor esperado y su longitud, y contrastarla con el limite del contenedor (aqui: el LENGTH del nodo DMEE); (4) ejecutar; (5) comparar exacto. Si no coinciden, NO parchear la salida: averiguar si fallo la config o el modelo. Claim 527.

rule: Un aviso heredado de un documento propio -- companion, especificacion, retro -- NO es evidencia. Antes de repetirlo como riesgo, y sobre todo antes de marcarlo CRITICO, medirlo. Y si la medida lo contradice, corregir el documento de origen, no solo la conversacion.
why: 2026-08-19: el companion decia 'lo unico que no hay que copiar: la R que falta -- Egipto debe definir los tres tipos de pago'. Lo repeti marcandolo en ROJO como 'lo unico que hoy romperia'. Al medirlo: en REGUH completa (3.707.737 lineas, 2016-2026, ejecutadas) el corte por DORIGIN da HR-PY 180.372 y TR-CM-BT 713, y NINGUNA llega a ninguno de los diez paises PPC -- todas con perceptor de direccion FR, y TR-CM-BT sin LIFNR porque es banco a banco. Verificado por los dos cortes, pais del BANCO del proveedor (lo que lee el control) y pais de la DIRECCION. O sea: los seis paises que si tienen filas R no las han disparado nunca, ni esas ni las P. El aviso original nunca se habia medido y yo lo ascendi a critico por herencia. Riesgo real de esto: gastar la credibilidad y el tiempo del usuario en lo que no pasa, mientras lo que si importaba -- avisar a la oficina de El Cairo de que el bloqueo empieza el dia del transporte -- no estaba en ninguna lista.
how_to_apply: Al citar un riesgo que viene de un artefacto propio y no de una medida: (1) marcarlo explicito como NO MEDIDO; (2) medirlo antes de priorizarlo -- casi siempre es una consulta al Gold DB o una lectura RFC; (3) declarar los cortes discriminantes de la tabla antes de contar; (4) si la medida lo rebaja, ACTUALIZAR el artefacto de origen en la misma sesion, con la cifra, para que el siguiente que lo lea no herede el error. Se aplico aqui: el companion y la desviacion 3 del incidente llevan ya la medida y la severidad rebajada.

rule: Un aviso regulatorio de un banco vincula EL CANAL DE ESE BANCO, no un pais. Antes de disenar nada, medir POR QUE CANAL sale realmente el flujo afectado y preguntar al banco que lo lleva. Si el que avisa no es el que transporta, puede que no haya nada que construir.
why: 2026-08-10 a 2026-08-20, Egipto. Citibank aviso de que exigiria Purpose of Payment en RTGS y CBFT hacia o desde Egipto. Se analizo con detalle COMO configurar Egipto, se construyo y se probo extremo a extremo. El 2026-08-20 SG confirmo que no existe codigo nuevo para Egipto y que el canal Citi no lleva ese flujo: la peticion decayo entera. LO GRAVE NO ES EL TRABAJO PERDIDO, ES QUE EL DATO ESTABA MEDIDO DESDE EL 2026-08-17: claim 492 'EGYPT IS 93.9% SOCGEN', claim 493 'cola de Citi 2,0% de las lineas', y el propio 492 escribio 'the Citi notice binds precisely the flow the framework cannot serve'. Ese hallazgo se leyo como una observacion sobre la cobertura de NUESTRO framework en vez de como lo que era: la prueba de que el mandato apunta a un canal que casi no usamos. Medimos lo correcto y derivamos el siguiente paso equivocado. Ademas, la cuenta Citi de Egipto emite el 100% por metodo 3 = cheque prenumerado, que no es ni RTGS ni CBFT -- es decir, ni siquiera la parte que si pasa por Citi estaba vinculada. Hermana de la regla de Track B 'la carta que autoriza es la especificacion, no la nota del solicitante': aqui la nota del solicitante ('anadir Egipto a la lista') traia dentro la premisa de que nuestra lista es el mecanismo que satisface al banco, y se valido el mecanismo sin tocar la premisa.
how_to_apply: MECANIZADA: `python brain_v2/house_bank_roles.py --country <ISO2>` responde en un vistazo quien sirve ese corredor, con que rol (DOMESTICO / CROSS-BORDER / MIXTO / PAPEL-cheque), que formato DMEE emite y si su pais despacha purpose codes. El censo completo es `house_bank_roles.py` sin argumentos y `--bank <HBKID>` da la ficha de uno. Se regenera en el paso 2d de rebuild_all.py; el artefacto consultable es brain_v2/house_bank_roles.json. PROTOCOLO ante un aviso de un banco: (1) correr `--country` del pais afectado ANTES de disenar nada; (2) si el banco que avisa no domina la fila, esa es la primera pregunta al negocio, antes que cualquier diseno: '¿nos vincula esto, y que dice el banco que lleva el resto?'; (3) un banco marcado PAPEL no tiene fichero que corregir; (4) el requisito solo esta confirmado cuando lo confirma el banco que OPERA el canal, no el que envio la circular. En Egipto: SOG01 93,1% frente a CIT19 0,9% en cheque. Claim 530.

rule: La carga de dominio no se hace UNA VEZ al arrancar: se REHACE cada vez que la conversacion se mueve a otro tema. Si llevas veinte intercambios hablando de algo que no cargaste, no estas informado: estas improvisando con datos frescos.
why: 2026-08-20. La sesion arranco cargando bien el dominio 'purpose of payment' -- 79 partes, dos companions, los claims. La conversacion se movio despues a BANCOS: rol, topologia, extractos. Nunca se recargo. Resultado: medi contra el Gold DB que 'SOG01 no tiene extractos bancarios' y estuve a un paso de publicarlo, cuando knowledge/domains/Treasury/bank_statement_ebs_architecture.md lo tenia medido y REFUTADO desde la sesion #029, en una seccion titulada literalmente 'FEBEP/FEBKO -- EBS IS FULLY ACTIVE (Critical Correction)': FEBKO 84.972 cabeceras, 99% contabilizado. El mismo documento describia el canal entero -- MT940 por SWIFT Alliance Lite2 a una carpeta, recogido por FF_5 -- que yo iba a derivar de cero. Lo aporto el usuario de memoria; estaba a un grep de distancia. La regla #208 cubre el arranque: 'en cuanto se nombre un tema, carga el dominio'. Su punto ciego es el MEDIO de la conversacion, que es justo donde el tema deriva sin que nadie lo anuncie. Y el coste es peor que al arrancar, porque para entonces ya llevas artefactos publicados sobre el tema nuevo.
how_to_apply: MECANIZADA en Zagentexecution/quality_checks/domain_load_coverage_check.py: compara los dominios de knowledge/domains/ escritos hoy (git) contra los temas que load_domain.py dejo en su directorio de trabajo, y FALLA si se escribio en serio (>=40 lineas) en un dominio que nunca se cargo. Un cambio menor no falla: corregir una errata no exige 600K tokens. Antes de MEDIR algo de un area que no cargaste, para y ejecuta `python brain_v2/load_domain.py <tema-nuevo>`. Senales de que el tema se movio: estas consultando tablas de otro dominio, escribiendo en un doc de otra carpeta knowledge/domains/, o el usuario ha introducido un sustantivo nuevo (bancos, extractos, nomina) que no estaba en la carga inicial. Y antes de publicar una medida que contradiga lo esperado, grepea el dominio por la tabla o el concepto: `grep -ril <TABLA> knowledge/`. Un resultado sorprendente es casi siempre una senal de que falta contexto, no un descubrimiento. Claim 535.

rule: No se retira NADA -- una regla, un claim, un script, un fichero, una tabla -- sin EVIDENCIA de que ya no aplica. Y la evidencia tiene que ser sobre la COSA, no sobre una metrica de proximidad: que algo no se cite, no se ejecute o no se haya tocado en meses NO es prueba de que no sirva.
why: 2026-08-20. Yo mismo propuse retirar 9 reglas para pagar la deuda de one_rule_in_one_rule_out, y el criterio que iba a usar era 'no aparece citada en ningun artefacto'. JP me paro: 'no retires nada nunca sin evidencia'. Tenia razon por dos motivos, y el segundo es peor que el primero. PRIMERO, LA METRICA ESTABA ROTA: el corpus con el que medi excluia claims.json e incidents.json, donde se citan 31 reglas. Publique 95 sin citar y 22 CRITICAL cuando el numero real era 72 y 22. SEGUNDO, Y ES EL DE FONDO: 'no citada' no mide utilidad, mide CITACION. Es el patron del claim 496 -- el control prueba presencia, no correccion -- aplicado por mi a las reglas que me gobiernan. Dos ejemplos de mi propia lista de candidatas: feedback_never_run_an_ungated_sap_writer es CRITICAL y protege contra la clase de incidente que corrompio las clases de N_MENARD -- sin citar y esencial; y feedback_never_sum_an_amount_across_currencies la VIOLE el dia anterior, y el claim 493 es la historia de esa violacion -- la regla estaba trabajando y mi medidor no la veia. Retirar por proximidad habria destruido controles vivos para cuadrar un contador. Y LA DEUDA NO SE PAGA ASI: one_rule_in_one_rule_out se paga MECANIZANDO o REUBICANDO, no borrando. En esta sesion se mecanizaron 4 de las 7 reglas nuevas -- ese es el pago real.
how_to_apply: Antes de retirar cualquier cosa, escribe la evidencia de que ya no aplica, y que sea sobre la cosa: (a) la condicion que guardaba ya no existe y se puede demostrar (el objeto se borro, el sistema cambio, la tabla no esta); (b) otra regla o mecanismo la cubre ENTERA, citando cual; (c) se demostro FALSA -- y entonces no se retira, se SUPERSEDE, que es lo que hace claims.json y por lo mismo (CP-002, preservar primero). Si la unica razon es 'nadie la cita', 'no se ha ejecutado' o 'lleva meses sin tocarse', NO ES EVIDENCIA: es una metrica de proximidad, y lo que hay que arreglar es el punto de uso, no la existencia. Una regla CRITICAL sin punto de uso se REUBICA al momento en que aplica -- a un check, a un agente, a un doc de dominio -- nunca se borra.

rule: Ante CUALQUIER pregunta sobre que hace realmente un job, una interfaz, un report o una corrida periodica: LEE LA VARIANTE antes de responder. El programa dice lo que se PUEDE hacer; la variante dice lo que SE HACE. Cadena obligatoria: TBTCO/TBTCP (que corrio) -> TBTCP.PROGNAME + TBTCP.VARIANTE -> RS_VARIANT_CONTENTS_RFC(REPORT, VARIANT) -> VALUTAB. Y corolario duro: un objeto puede estar PERFECTAMENTE CONFIGURADO y no procesarse NUNCA porque no entra en la seleccion de ninguna variante -- sin error, en silencio. Toda auditoria de configuracion que no cruce contra la variante esta incompleta por construccion.
why: 2026-08-20 (s102). JP: 'ya tenias la capacidad de leer reports y variantes, eso es una capacidad super importante... las variantes definen mucho los procesos ya que como las generan contienen combinaciones unicas'. Cada variante se crea a mano para un caso concreto: es una combinacion que no esta en ninguna documentacion, y es donde el proceso se instancia. Sin este paso, un analisis de jobs solo sabe QUE algo corrio; con el, sabe QUE HIZO -- incluida la RUTA DONDE UNA INTERFAZ DEJA SUS FICHEROS, que es un parametro de la variante y no esta en ningun sitio mas. El bloqueo era doble y ambos lados eran falsos: el skill sap_variant_analysis y sap_variant_forensic_methodology.md afirmaban que VARI/VARID/VARIS son pool tables y que 'no hay workaround via RFC'. DD02L dice TRANSP en las tres, el contenido esta en VARI-CLUSTD (campo RAW de 2.886 bytes) y RS_VARIANT_CONTENTS_RFC esta remote-enabled y funciona sobre P01 sin S_DEVELOP. Una creencia equivocada escrita en un skill bloqueo durante sesiones un analisis de segundos. Medido el mismo dia: de las 5 cuentas 40410xx con filas en T030H, solo 2 estan en una variante -- el resto lleva anos configurado sin ejecutarse.
how_to_apply: 1) Inventario: RFC_READ_TABLE sobre VARID WHERE REPORT = '<PROG>' (transparente, multi-campo, funciona). 2) Contenido: conn.call('RS_VARIANT_CONTENTS_RFC', REPORT=..., VARIANT=..., VALUTAB=[]) y recorre VALUTAB (SELNAME/KIND/SIGN/OPTION/LOW/HIGH). KIND 'P' = parametro simple, 'S' = select-option. 3) NO ASUMAS EL MECANISMO DE SELECCION: cambia entre variantes del MISMO programa. En SAPF100/UNES, UNES_DEPOSIT usa 16 valores EQ sueltos mientras UNES_UNBA usa rangos BT -- decir 'se anade por rangos' es erroneo la mitad de las veces. 4) Lee TAMBIEN los parametros que no son rangos: rutas de fichero, fechas, metodo de valoracion y flags de modo (X_SALBEW, X_GL, ST_BUDAT, TESTLAUF) son la mitad del proceso. 5) Cruza SIEMPRE config x seleccion (p.ej. T030H x variante) y reporta lo configurado-pero-no-seleccionado. 6) Si un FM parece no existir, preguntale al sistema: TFDIR WHERE FMODE = 'R' AND FUNCNAME LIKE '%<TEMA>%'. Skill: .agents/skills/sap_variant_analysis/SKILL.md.

rule: MASTER DATA ESTANDAR SE ESCRIBE POR LA API ESTANDAR DEL OBJETO, NUNCA CON INSERT PLANO. RFC_ABAP_INSTALL_AND_RUN con INSERT solo es legitimo sobre tablas PROPIAS Y*/Z*, o bajo una EXCEPCION AUTORIZADA registrada nominalmente. La tecnica NO es 'escribir sin ABAP': genera e instala un report ABAP al vuelo y lo ejecuta. Canales medidos: GL -> GL_ACCT_MASTER_SAVE_RFC (lectura GET_COA_RFC + GET_CCODE_RFC) · centros de coste -> BAPI_COSTCENTER_CREATEMULTIPLE · fondos -> FM_FUND_CREATE_RFC · centros gestores -> FM_FUNDS_CTR_CREATE_RFC · proyectos/WBS -> BAPI_PROJECT_MAINTAIN + BAPI_TRANSACTION_COMMIT. Centros de beneficio NO se usan en UNESCO. Y el flag de simulacion es INVERSO entre APIs: omitir I_FLG_TESTRUN en FM_FUND_CREATE_RFC SIMULA en silencio; omitir TESTMODE en GL_ACCT_MASTER_SAVE_RFC ESCRIBE DE VERDAD. Pasalo siempre explicito y verifica RELEYENDO, nunca por RETURN. Y hay un PELDANO INTERMEDIO que faltaba: para CUSTOMIZING sin API, BC-Sets (SCPRMP_UPDATE_BCSET_REMOTE para poblar + SCPR_ACTIV_MN_REMOTE_SUB para activar) escriben POR EL FRAMEWORK y graban en orden -- con un bootstrap manual del BC-Set, que no es RFC.
why: 2026-08-20 (s102). Propuse sincronizar cuentas GL con RFC_ABAP_INSTALL_AND_RUN + INSERT sobre SKA1/SKAT/SKB1. JP me paro: eso esta explicitamente prohibido. Y tenia razon por partida doble. PRIMERO, la respuesta correcta YA ESTABA ESCRITA desde junio en Zagentexecution/tasks/2026_06_29_fm_model_sync/METHOD.md ('Verified write channels -- NOT flat INSERT for standard master'), y yo lei el SKILL.md de sap_master_data_sync, que prescribia lo contrario y ademas citaba un script (copy_gl_accounts_p01_to_d01.py) QUE NO EXISTE. Dos artefactos del mismo proyecto en contradiccion, y el equivocado era el que se lee primero. SEGUNDO, el skill afirmaba que no habia canal para GL ('BAPI_GL_ACCOUNT_CREATE no existe', 'GL_ACCT_MASTER_MAINTAIN_RFC falla'): el canal existe y es GL_ACCT_MASTER_SAVE_RFC, recuperado preguntandole a TFDIR, no al skill. El coste tecnico de haberlo hecho mal: un INSERT plano salta derivacion, rangos de numeracion, validez, jerarquia y checks, y deja un registro que parece correcto en la tabla y esta roto para el proceso.
how_to_apply: 1) ANTES de escribir master data, mira la matriz de canales en .agents/skills/sap_master_data_sync/SKILL.md y en el agente master-data-sync. 2) Si el objeto no esta en la matriz, o si un artefacto dice 'no hay canal': PREGUNTALE AL SISTEMA, RFC_READ_TABLE sobre TFDIR WHERE FMODE='R' AND FUNCNAME LIKE '%<OBJETO>%'. El diccionario del sistema gana a cualquier documentacion nuestra. 3) Introspecciona la forma REAL de los parametros con conn.get_function_description(FM) y recorre type_description.fields recursivamente: las API GL_ACCT_MASTER_* exponen estructuras ANIDADAS (KEYY/DATA/INFO/ACTION), no campos planos, y pasar {'KTOPL':...} da RFC_INVALID_PARAMETER. RFC_GET_FUNCTION_INTERFACE da los tipos DDIC pero NO esa forma. 4) ACTION es obligatorio en las API GL: 'I' alta, 'U' modificacion; sin el responde FH502 'Import of table SKA1 not possible', que suena a fallo tecnico y es solo la accion vacia. 5) Flag de test SIEMPRE explicito, en los dos sentidos. 6) Un registro primero, readback campo a campo, luego el lote. 7) Readback final obligatorio: diferencias esperadas solo en ERDAT/ERNAM. 8) LA ESCALERA TIENE TRES PELDANOS: (1) API estandar; (2) BC-Set para customizing sin API; (3) INSERT generado por ABAP, prohibido salvo tablas propias o EXCEPCION AUTORIZADA. 9) Las excepciones viven en una LISTA CERRADA en .agents/skills/sap_master_data_sync/SKILL.md -> 'REGISTRO DE EXCEPCIONES AUTORIZADAS'. Hoy hay UNA: EXC-001, version de balance (FAGL_011PC/QT/ZC/SC, chart UNES, destinos D01 y V01, SOLO INSERT de filas ausentes, autorizada por JP el 2026-08-20). Lo que no este en esa tabla NO esta autorizado, y NO se extiende por analogia. 10) Toda excepcion pasa las DIEZ PUERTAS del skill, y la G10 no es opcional: registrar despues las claves escritas en una orden de customizing y validarla con config_transport_prerelease_check.py, porque un INSERT en crudo no queda en ninguna orden y D01 es el ORIGEN de los transportes hacia P01.

rule: Cuando se replica master data de P01 a D01/V01, DECLARAR SIEMPRE lo que la replica NO trae. Copiar la cuenta/fondo/centro no trae su CUSTOMIZING: version de balance (FAGL_011ZC via OB58), determinacion de cuentas (T030H via OB09), variantes de ejecucion (no se transportan, VARID.TRANSPORT='F'), derivacion, sets. Decir 'alineado' cuando solo lo esta el master data es una afirmacion falsa que el usuario descubrira cuando una prueba no reproduzca produccion.
why: 2026-08-20 (s102). Deje D01 y V01 con las cuentas GL de UNES al 100% y JP pregunto si la asignacion al balance venia con la copia. No venia. Medido: a D01 le faltan 195 intervalos de FAGL_011ZC y a V01 131, mas 287/278 filas de jerarquia de posiciones. Y el modo de fallo es traicionero: un RANGO no cubre nada si la FILA del rango no existe, y eso no se ve mirando la cuenta sino el intervalo. En P01 la peticion de Treasury se cumplio sola porque el intervalo 4041015-4041019 ya estaba; fuera de P01 no existe esa fila. El mismo dia se vio que la variante UNES_DEPOSIT tiene TRES contenidos distintos en los tres sistemas.
how_to_apply: 1) Al cerrar un sync, publicar DOS cifras: master data alineado, y customizing pendiente. 2) Correr los medidores: Zagentexecution/quality_checks/fsv_alignment_check.py (FSV) y ob09_vs_variant_check.py (determinacion de cuentas x variante). 3) Para el customizing NO inventar canal: si TFDIR no da un FM remote-enabled, el canal es la transaccion (OB58, OB09) o una orden de customizing, y lo que produce el agente es la ESPECIFICACION, no la escritura. Las tablas FAGL_011*/T030H son ESTANDAR: INSERT plano prohibido. 4) Nunca afirmar 'D01/V01 reproduce P01' sin haber comparado tambien la variante que selecciona los objetos.

rule: ANTES DE AFIRMAR, NOMBRA LA FUENTE Y COMPRUEBA QUE SOPORTA LA AFIRMACION. Cuatro formas de que no la soporte, y las cuatro pasaron el mismo dia: (a) UNA LECTURA FALLIDA NO ES AUSENCIA -- si la consulta devolvio error, campo inexistente o TABLE_WITHOUT_DATA, el resultado es DESCONOCIDO, nunca 'no hay'; (b) UN CACHE NO ES EL SISTEMA -- el Gold DB va meses por detras y no tiene el ejercicio en curso; (c) UN PROXY NO ES LA COSA -- la moneda de TRANSACCION dice en que se movio algo, no que quede exposicion abierta; (d) LEER N DE M CAMPOS Y CONCLUIR ES NO HABER LEIDO -- si el objeto tiene tres candados, mirar dos y dar via libre es peor que no mirar. Y el corolario para el instrumental: un check que no distingue 'no hay' de 'no pude ver' devuelve exit 0 con la lectura reventada, que es la peor salida posible.
why: 2026-08-20/21 (s102). Cuatro veces en una sesion afirme algo que mi fuente no soportaba, y las cuatro las cazo JP preguntando en vez de aceptar. (1) 'cero BC-Sets en D01, nunca se ha usado esta via' -- consulte SCPRATTR por el campo SCPRSGUID, que no existe, y lei el TABLE_WITHOUT_DATA como ausencia; hay 2.181. (2) 'via libre para SCU0' -- imprimi T000.CCCOPYLOCK='L' en mi propia salida y me quede con CCCORACTIV y CCNOCLIIND; el tercero es justo el que bloquea la comparacion (TB569). (3) 'tres defectos vivos de revaluacion' -- lei euros en GLT0.RTCUR, que es moneda de transaccion, y llame exposicion a movimientos ya compensados. (4) al corregirme, 'no hay exposicion, todo compensado' -- use el Gold DB, que no tiene 2026; en vivo, 4041011 tiene 20 M EUR en cuatro partidas abiertas, dos de ese mismo dia. La numero 4 duele especialmente: es la regla que el propio skill sap_master_data_sync enuncia -nunca el cache para analisis de hueco- y que yo aplique al sync de GL y viole en el analisis de partidas media hora despues.
how_to_apply: 1) Al escribir una afirmacion, escribe al lado DE DONDE SALE. Si no puedes, no la escribas. 2) Antes de leer una tabla que no conoces, mira sus campos (DD03L o get_function_description): el campo inventado devuelve TABLE_WITHOUT_DATA y parece un dato. 3) Distingue SIEMPRE tres estados -- SI / NO / DESCONOCIDO -- en el codigo y en la prosa; el tercero no es un fallo del analisis, es un resultado. 4) Para exposicion financiera: partidas ABIERTAS (BSIS) frente a COMPENSADAS (BSAS), en vivo y cuenta a cuenta; GLT0 y los saldos no valen. 5) Para cualquier analisis de hueco entre sistemas: LIVE, nunca el Gold DB. 6) Cuando un objeto tiene varios atributos de control, enumeralos TODOS antes de concluir (T000 tiene tres candados: CCCORACTIV, CCNOCLIIND, CCCOPYLOCK). 7) Si el usuario cuestiona una conclusion, la respuesta correcta casi nunca es defenderla: es medir lo que no mediste.

rule: UN OBJETO DE CONFIGURACION EXISTE PARA TODOS Y SE EJECUTA PARA ALGUNOS: antes de medir una poblacion contra el, DEMUESTRA que se le aplica. Que la version de balance FS11 exista para el plan UNES no significa que UNES la use -- la ejecutan 16 variantes de RFBILA00 y las 16 son de IIEP o ICTP. Medir las 1.018 cuentas de UNES contra FS11 fabrico un hueco de 68 cuentas y 144 millones de euros que no existe. Contra FS10, la que UNES ejecuta de verdad, el hueco son 4 cuentas que suman 0,01 EUR. El mismo dato, el denominador equivocado, y una alarma inventada.
why: Es la hermana de feedback_declare_the_cuts_before_measuring, pero en el otro lado de la ecuacion: alli el corte esta en los DATOS (quien cobra, por que via), aqui esta en la CONFIGURACION (para quien corre esto). La tabla de customizing no lleva el corte: T011 no dice que sociedad usa cada version, T030H no dice que cuentas se valoran de verdad, un arbol DMEE no dice que corredor lo despacha. Quien lo sabe es lo que EJECUTA la configuracion. Publicar sin ese corte no es un error de calculo: es inventar un problema y hacer que alguien lo persiga.
how_to_apply: 1) Antes de barrer una poblacion contra una configuracion, pregunta QUIEN la ejecuta y con que restriccion. Para un report, la respuesta esta en la VARIANTE (RFBILA00 -> parametro BILAVERS + SD_BUKRS); para un pago, en el arbol y el corredor; para una valoracion, en la variante de F.05. 2) Si una version tiene 0 entradas para tu plan/sociedad, no esta en uso para ti: descartala, no la cuentes como hueco. 3) Usa la REFERENCIA como patron: si la cuenta de referencia del formulario tampoco esta cubierta, esa configuracion es SELECTIVA por diseno y no te falta nada. 4) Metelo en el instrumento, no en la cabeza: fsv_coverage_check.py deriva la version en uso leyendo las variantes y se niega a llamar hueco a lo que no se ejecuta.

rule: UN DOMINIO DE GOBIERNO DE DATOS MAESTROS NO ES UNA CARPETA, ES UN REGISTRO DE TIPOS DE OBJETO. Cuando se pregunta por governance de master data tienen que aparecer los subdominios -- cuenta de mayor, centro de coste, clase de coste, fondo, centro gestor, posicion presupuestaria, proyecto/PEP, proveedor/BP, banco casa -- cada uno con su autoridad de alta, su canal MEDIDO, su ejecutor y sus tareas posteriores. Store: brain_v2/master_data_registry.json; companion generado por scripts/build_master_data_companion.py.
why: Un dominio descrito solo en prosa contesta la pregunta que ya sabias hacer. Un registro contesta la que no: 'y para un fondo, que canal hay?'. Ademas hace VISIBLE la brecha en vez de esconderla -- de 10 tipos, 1 esta mecanizado y 7 tienen canal medido sin ejecutor. Eso es una brecha honesta y accionable; la prosa la habria dejado en silencio. Medir el inventario tambien corrigio dos creencias falsas de golpe (las clases de coste SI tienen canal; los BAPI_BANKDETAIL* NO son del banco casa).
how_to_apply: 1) Al tocar un tipo de objeto maestro nuevo, anadelo al registro con su estado MEDIDO -- no supuesto: MECANIZADO / CANAL_SIN_EJECUTOR / SIN_CANAL / NO_APLICA. 2) El canal se mide en TFDIR (FMODE='R'), no se recuerda. 3) El companion se GENERA del registro: edita el registro, nunca el HTML. 4) Alta un alias en load_domain.py por el nombre del OBJETO, no solo del dominio: quien pregunta por 'centro de coste' no sabe que el dominio se llama Master_Data_Governance.

rule: UN SELECT-OPTION QUE SOLO TIENE EXCLUSIONES SIGNIFICA 'TODO MENOS ESO', NUNCA 'NADA'. Y CADA CAMPO ES UN UNIVERSO DISTINTO: no los mezcles. Medido 2026-08-21 en la variante UNES_OI_AR/AP de SAPF100: el campo AKONTO trae 27 lineas y las 27 son SIGN='E', sin una sola inclusion -> la variante valora TODAS las cuentas asociadas de submayor MENOS esas 27. Leerlo como conjunto vacio daba 549 cuentas 'fuera de toda variante' cuando son 497, y de las 69 cuentas asociadas marcaba 68 como huerfanas cuando son 16.
why: Son dos errores encadenados y los dos producen alarma inventada. (1) La semantica: un rango de seleccion vacio en ABAP significa 'sin restriccion'; anadirle solo exclusiones sigue significando 'sin restriccion, salvo estas'. Un lector ingenuo cuenta inclusiones, encuentra cero y concluye que no entra nada. (2) La mezcla de campos: SKONTO selecciona cuentas de MAYOR y AKONTO cuentas ASOCIADAS de submayor. Son universos distintos con reglas distintas; volcarlos en un unico conjunto pierde cual manda para cada cuenta, y una cuenta asociada preguntada por SKONTO sale siempre 'fuera'.
how_to_apply: 1) Al leer una variante, guarda la seleccion POR CAMPO, no en un saco comun: `variant_selection()` en ob09_vs_variant_check.py. 2) Para cada campo, si no hay ninguna linea con SIGN='I', el conjunto es TODO menos las 'E'. 3) Elige el campo por la naturaleza de la cuenta: SKB1-MITKZ lleno -> AKONTO; vacio -> SKONTO. 4) Y antes de publicar un recuento de 'objetos fuera del alcance', comprueba el orden de magnitud contra alguien que conozca el proceso: 549 sono mal a JP en el acto, y tenia razon.

rule:
AL RESOLVER UN INCIDENTE, COMPROBAR SI TIENE CONOCIMIENTO O DOMINIO RELACIONADO -- y si no lo tiene, ESCRIBIRLO. Un incidente cerrado con su documento de caso y nada mas es un expediente, no conocimiento: el proximo igual vuelve a costar lo mismo. Medido 2026-08-21: **11 de 13 incidentes no tenian documento de PROCESO en su dominio**, y los 2 que si lo tenian son los dos que se tocaron ese dia porque JP lo pidio.
